newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open flat to off 0.20 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open flat to off 0.20 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open flat to off 0.20 cent Thursday as LME traded unchanged overnight despite a hefty drop in stocks and slightly wider backwardation.
LME stocks fell 3,550 tonnes to 133,025 tonnes Thursday.
COMEX stocks on Wednesday rose 534 short tons to 42,931 short tons.
On ACCESS, COMEX July copper last traded at 119.20 cents a lb, off 0.25 cent from Wednesday's close.
The LME backwardation widened slightly overnight to $73/$78.

Dealers in Shanghai overnight said copper was ripe for a downside price correction following its heady gains, and this could result in significant buying by China which, they said, needed to import some 300,000 tonnes of copper this year.
